description: App config contract change (design commit 1, `feat(cache)!`): build Redis/DB clients from Sentinel + CNPG-sourced discrete config while keeping plain URLs for local dev. Makes database_url/redis_url optional, adds the PG_* discrete set + database_dsn composer and the Redis Sentinel fields with two-mode validators, rewires cache.py/db.py/main.py/migrations/env.py, and updates the unit tests + .env.example. health.py and items.py are intentionally UNTOUCHED (the Sentinel master_for client is API-identical for get/set/delete/ping). Independent of the manifest FEATs except that FEAT-002's manifests project the PG_* env this FEAT teaches the app to read.
steps: src/app/config.py: make `database_url: str | None = None` and `redis_url: str | None = None`. Add discrete DB fields `pg_host: str | None`, `pg_port: int | None`, `pg_user: str | None`, `pg_password: str | None`, `pg_dbname: str | None`. Add Sentinel fields `redis_sentinel_hosts: str | None`, `redis_master_name: str = Field(default="mymaster", min_length=1)` (import `Field` from pydantic), `redis_password: str | None`. Add `@property redis_is_sentinel -> bool` returning `bool(self.redis_sentinel_hosts)`. Add `@property database_dsn -> str`: return `self.database_url` when set, else compose `postgresql+asyncpg://{quote(pg_user, safe='')}:{quote(pg_password, safe='')}@{pg_host}:{pg_port}/{pg_dbname}` using `urllib.parse.quote` (quote BOTH user and password). Add `@model_validator(mode="after")` that raises ValueError if neither `redis_sentinel_hosts` nor `redis_url` is set, and if neither `database_url` nor the full (`pg_host`,`pg_port`,`pg_user`,`pg_password`,`pg_dbname`) set is present. Keep the existing DD_* comment. Annotate the validator return as the forward-ref string 'Settings'; no Any; mypy --strict clean.

src/app/cache.py: add `parse_sentinel_hosts(raw: str) -> list[tuple[str, int]]` (split on commas, each `host:port`, port an int in 1..65535, raise ValueError naming malformed input). Change signature to `create_redis(settings: Settings) -> Redis`: if `settings.redis_sentinel_hosts`, build `Sentinel(parse_sentinel_hosts(settings.redis_sentinel_hosts), sentinel_kwargs={"password": settings.redis_password}, password=settings.redis_password, decode_responses=True)` and return `.master_for(settings.redis_master_name)`; else `return Redis.from_url(settings.redis_url, decode_responses=True)` guarded by an invariant check (an explicit `if settings.redis_url is None: raise RuntimeError(...)` is acceptable if ruff flags an assert). Import `Sentinel` from `redis.asyncio.sentinel` and `Settings` from `app.config`.

src/app/db.py: in `create_engine(database_url: str)` normalize a leading `postgresql://` to `postgresql+asyncpg://`; parse the query with `urllib.parse.urlsplit` + `parse_qsl` and raise `ValueError` that NAMES the offending parameter(s) ONLY when the query contains a key in {sslmode, sslrootcert, sslcert, sslkey, sslpassword, gssencmode, sslnegotiation} (case-insensitive). Leave every other query param untouched (do NOT blanket-ban `?`). Keep `pool_pre_ping=True`.
src/app/main.py: change the lifespan to `create_engine(resolved.database_dsn)` and `create_redis(resolved)` (were `resolved.database_url` and `create_redis(resolved.redis_url)`).
migrations/env.py: change `get_url()` to `return Settings().database_dsn` (keeps the `-> str` annotation correct).

tests/unit/test_config.py: REPLACE `test_missing_required_field_raises` with mode-matrix cases — DB: DATABASE_URL alone ok; full PG_* alone ok (database_dsn composes); neither -> ValidationError. Redis: REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS alone ok and `redis_is_sentinel is True`; REDIS_URL set -> ok and `redis_is_sentinel is False`; neither -> ValidationError. Add a `database_dsn` composition test (discrete PG_* -> clean postgresql+asyncpg:// with NO query string, including a case with a URL-reserved char in BOTH user and password to prove percent-quoting). Add a case asserting REDIS_MASTER_NAME='' raises ValidationError. Adjust `test_required_fields_read_from_env` so it no longer asserts either field is required.

tests/unit/test_cache.py (NEW): unit tests for `parse_sentinel_hosts` (valid, malformed, bad port) and `create_redis` mode selection via monkeypatch/mocks on `redis.asyncio.sentinel.Sentinel` and `Redis.from_url` (NO network). Assert the Sentinel path constructs `Sentinel(...)` with the parsed hosts, is passed `decode_responses=True`, and calls `.master_for(master_name)`; assert the plain path calls `Redis.from_url(redis_url, ...)`.

tests/unit/test_db.py (NEW): string-only, no DB. Assert scheme normalization postgresql://->postgresql+asyncpg://; an already-+asyncpg URL is untouched; a `?sslmode=require` URL raises ValueError whose message names `sslmode`; a non-libpq query param (`?prepared_statement_cache_size=0`) and a bare `?ssl=disable` are ACCEPTED unchanged.
tests/conftest.py: keep `placeholder_env` setting plain DATABASE_URL + REDIS_URL; add a comment that this keeps app-building tests in local plain mode.
tests/integration/test_items_api.py: add a docstring note that integration uses plain Redis (Docker Compose) and the Sentinel construction path is covered by the mocked unit test.

.env.example: keep the existing DATABASE_URL + REDIS_URL local-dev lines; append the commented, explicitly mutually-exclusive cluster-only Sentinel block from design §D verbatim (REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS/REDIS_MASTER_NAME/REDIS_PASSWORD commented out, the warning that uncommenting switches to Sentinel and REDIS_URL must be removed, and the note that in-cluster DATABASE_URL is composed from CNPG PG_* keys).
acceptance_criteria: `uv run poe check` passes: ruff lint clean, mypy --strict clean (including migrations/env.py typechecks and imports), and all unit tests pass with NO services running.

config.Settings accepts DATABASE_URL-only, full-PG_*-only, and (for Redis) REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS-only or REDIS_URL-only; rejects 'neither' for each mode with a ValidationError; REDIS_MASTER_NAME='' is rejected.
database_dsn composes a query-string-free postgresql+asyncpg:// URL with both user and password percent-quoted.
create_redis selects Sentinel vs plain by redis_sentinel_hosts and passes decode_responses=True on the Sentinel path (asserted by test_cache.py).
create_engine rejects only the named libpq query params and leaves other query params untouched (asserted by test_db.py).
